marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind west 20 knots increasing to northwest 35 this morning then
diminishing to northwest 20 early Wednesday morning. Wind diminishing to light
Wednesday afternoon. Scattered flurries ending Wednesday afternoon. Visibility
as low as 1 mile in flurries. Temperatures near zero. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre building to 2 near noon then
subsiding to 1 Wednesday morning.<br/>
